import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static MatrixType baseMat = new MatrixType();
    static MatrixType[] A = new MatrixType[MAXN];
    static MatrixType[] prefix = new MatrixType[MAXN];
    static MatrixType[] suffix = new MatrixType[MAXN];
    static MatrixType answer = new MatrixType();

    static class MatrixType {
        int[][] mat = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

        void reset() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                    mat[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void print() {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                    System.out.print(mat[i][j] + (j == n + 1 ? "\n" : " "));
                }
            }
            System.out.println();
        }

        MatrixType multiply(MatrixType rhs) {
            MatrixType res = new MatrixType();
            res.reset();
            for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 1; k <= n + 1; k++) {
                        sum += (long) this.mat[i][k] * rhs.mat[k][j];
                    }
                    res.mat[i][j] = (int) (sum % MOD);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int input(Scanner sc) {
        return sc.nextInt();
    }

    static long inputLong(Scanner sc) {
        return sc.nextLong();
    }

    static void addTo(int[] x, int y) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= MOD) x[0] -= MOD;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m = inputLong(sc);
        n = input(sc);

        baseMat.reset();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            baseMat.mat[i][i] = 1;
        }
        answer = new MatrixType();
        answer.mat = copyMatrix(baseMat.mat);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            A[i] = new MatrixType();
            A[i].mat = copyMatrix(baseMat.mat);
            A[i].mat[i][i] = 1;
        }

        prefix[0] = new MatrixType();
        prefix[0].mat = copyMatrix(baseMat.mat);
        suffix[n + 1] = new MatrixType();
        suffix[n + 1].mat = copyMatrix(baseMat.mat);

        while (m != 0) {
            long u = m % n;
            if (u != 0) {
                long s = 0;
                for (long v = m; v != 0; v /= n) {
                    s = (s + v / n) % n;
                }
                u = (s + u - 1) % n + 1;
                while (u != s) {
                    if (u <= 0) u += n;
                    answer = A[(int) u].multiply(answer);
                    u--;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                prefix[i] = prefix[i - 1].multiply(A[i]);
            }
            for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
                suffix[i] = A[i].multiply(suffix[i + 1]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                A[i] = suffix[i].multiply(prefix[i - 1]);
            }
            m /= n;
        }

        int total = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            int[] temp = {total};
            addTo(temp, answer.mat[n + 1][i]);
            total = temp[0];
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int[][] copyMatrix(int[][] src) {
        int[][] dest = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(src[i], 0, dest[i], 0, MAXN);
        }
        return dest;
    }
}
